sources.title: About Market Data API
mapped_claims: Basic pricing is free.
U.S. stock and ETF history begins in 2016.
Basic permits 200 historical API calls per minute and restricts only the latest fifteen minutes.

sources.title: Market Data FAQ
sources.relevant_section: Stocks - difference between IEX and SIP data
mapped_claims: Historical SIP is available without a subscription when explicit end is at least fifteen minutes old.
The historical feed parameter selects SIP or IEX.
Minute bars use left-inclusive, right-exclusive trade buckets labeled by the left boundary.

sources.title: Historical bars
mapped_claims: The endpoint is GET https://data.alpaca.markets/v2/stocks/bars and supports native 5Min bars.
Start and end are inclusive.
Limit is at most 10,000 total data points per page and pagination uses page_token and next_page_token.
Feed sip covers all U.S. exchanges.
Adjustment supports raw, split, dividend, spin-off, all, and comma-separated combinations including split,spin-off.

sources.title: Historical API
mapped_claims: Alpaca describes historical data as usable for charting, backtesting, and trading strategies.
This usage statement is not an express retention or reproduction license.

sources.title: Alpaca Customer Agreement V26.2026.07
sources.relevant_section: Sections 1, 2(d), and 30 - Use of Market Data
mapped_claims: The agreement incorporates the Nasdaq and NYSE subscriber agreements when applicable.
Section 30 prohibits reproducing, distributing, selling, or commercially exploiting market data without Alpaca's written consent.
The agreement does not expressly permit private immutable raw copies, backups, or retained derived audit artifacts.

sources.title: Alpaca - Disclosures and Agreements
mapped_claims: Alpaca links the Nasdaq OMX Global Subscriber Agreement and NYSE Market Data Display Services Agreement as current securities agreements.

sources.title: NASDAQ OMX Global Subscriber Agreement Version 2013.1
mapped_claims: A non-professional subscriber receives a personal-use license and may not provide access to another person or place.
Section 2 permits later use only as allowed by the agreement and applicable Nasdaq requirements.
The text does not expressly grant immutable local reproduction, backup, or research-archive rights.

sources.title: Agreement for Market Data Display Services
mapped_claims: A subscriber may not furnish market data to another person or entity.
A non-professional subscriber may receive market data only for personal, non-business use.
The text does not expressly grant immutable local reproduction, backup, or research-archive rights.

access_history.initial_nasdaq_and_nyse_pdf_retrieval_ga: The first review reported HTTP 403 responses for both incorporated agreement PDFs.
access_history.final_retrieval: Both provider-linked PDFs returned HTTP 200 and were reviewed before this manifest was frozen.

retention_assessment.reason: Personal non-business use and backtesting are described, but Alpaca separately prohibits reproduction without written consent and no reviewed agreement expressly authorizes immutable local raw copies, backups, or retained derived audit artifacts.

mutable_source_warning: These provider-controlled pages and linked agreements may change without preserving the retrieved representation. Re-fetch and re-hash every source immediately before any future authority; any content or link change requires a fresh contractual review.
